```{r}
# =========================================================================
# PM computation-method comparison plot
#
# Holds the prior fixed within each column (Flat / Jeffreys / log-F /
# Bayesian ridge) and varies the PM computation method (quadrature /
# MacKay / self-projection / CITL-preserving self-projection) within
# each panel. Aggregates across design factors (true_p, candidate_p,
# prevalence): the message of this plot is "computation choice barely
# matters relative to prior choice", and that's clearest when not
# stratified by design factor. Y-axis is matched to the main plots'
# per-metric range.
#
# Structurally analogous to GUSTO's gusto_pm_comp.png:
#   rows = metrics, cols = prior family, x = EPV, dodged by computation.
# =========================================================================

computation_labels <- c(
  exact = "Quadrature (exact)",
  mk    = "MacKay",
  pp    = "Self-projection",
  cpp   = "CITL-preserving proj."
)
computation_colors <- c(
  exact = "#1F4E79",
  mk    = "#2E75B6",
  pp    = "#E07B00",
  cpp   = "#B22222"
)
computation_shapes <- c(
  exact = 16,
  mk    = 17,
  pp    = 15,
  cpp   = 18
)
computation_order <- c("exact", "mk", "pp") #, "cpp")

family_labels <- c(
  f  = "Flat prior",
  j  = "Jeffreys (Firth)",
  lf = "log-F(2, 2)",
  br = "Gaussian (Bayes. ridge)"
)
family_order <- c("f", "j", "lf", "br")

parse_pm_method <- function(key) {
  parts <- strsplit(key, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) < 2 || parts[1] != "pm") {
    return(c(family = NA_character_, computation = NA_character_))
  }
  fam  <- parts[2]
  comp <- if (length(parts) == 2) "exact" else parts[3]
  c(family = fam, computation = comp)
}

# ---- Capture per-metric y-limits from the main plots' aggregation ----
# Replicates the central+whisker computation of build_plot but extracts
# per-metric (ymin, ymax) across all methods and EPV values, aggregated
# across the design factor. The comp plot will use these to anchor each
# row's y-range so the visual scale matches the main plots.
get_main_plot_ylims <- function(data,
                                method_order  = default_method_order,
                                metric_order  = default_metric_order,
                                summary_spec  = metric_summary_spec) {
  comp_suffixes <- c("mk", "pp", "cpp")  # Laplace computation variants only
  is_main <- function(k) {
    parts <- strsplit(k, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(parts) < 1) return(FALSE)
    if (parts[1] == "pe") return(TRUE)
    if (parts[1] == "pm") {
      if (length(parts) <= 2) return(TRUE)
      return(!parts[length(parts)] %in% comp_suffixes)  # allow e.g. pm_br_mcmc
    }
    TRUE
  }
  avail <- unique(as.character(data$method))
  known <- names(method_labels)
  candidates <- intersect(avail, known)
  candidates <- candidates[vapply(candidates, is_main, logical(1))]

  data <- data %>%
    filter(as.character(method) %in% candidates) %>%
    filter(as.character(metric) %in% metric_labels[metric_order]) %>%
    mutate(metric = as.character(metric))

  data$metric_key <- names(metric_labels)[match(data$metric, metric_labels)]

  # Aggregate by (metric, method, epv) — same grouping as build_plot but
  # without the design-factor column, so per-metric limits average over
  # all design configurations and all main-plot methods.
  agg <- data %>%
    group_by(metric, metric_key, method, epv) %>%
    summarise(
      lo = compute_lower(value, get_summary_spec(first(metric_key), summary_spec)$range),
      hi = compute_upper(value, get_summary_spec(first(metric_key), summary_spec)$range),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(-metric_key)

  agg %>%
    group_by(metric) %>%
    summarise(ymin = min(lo, na.rm = TRUE),
              ymax = max(hi, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")
}




build_computation_plot <- function(data, figure_title = NULL,
                                   metric_order  = default_metric_order,
                                   summary_spec  = metric_summary_spec,
                                   y_limits      = NULL) {

  pm_keys <- unique(as.character(data$method))
  pm_keys <- pm_keys[grepl("^pm_", pm_keys)]
  parsed  <- t(sapply(pm_keys, parse_pm_method))
  valid   <- !is.na(parsed[, "family"]) &
             parsed[, "family"]      %in% family_order &
             parsed[, "computation"] %in% computation_order
  pm_keys <- pm_keys[valid]
  parsed  <- parsed[valid, , drop = FALSE]

  if (length(pm_keys) == 0) {
    warning("No PM methods found for computation-comparison plot")
    return(NULL)
  }

  key_to_family <- setNames(parsed[, "family"], pm_keys)
  key_to_comp   <- setNames(parsed[, "computation"], pm_keys)

  data <- data %>%
    filter(as.character(method) %in% pm_keys) %>%
    mutate(
      method      = as.character(method),
      family      = factor(unname(key_to_family[method]), levels = family_order),
      computation = factor(unname(key_to_comp[method]),   levels = computation_order)
    )

  data <- data %>%
    filter(as.character(metric) %in% metric_labels[metric_order]) %>%
    mutate(metric = factor(as.character(metric),
                           levels = metric_labels[metric_order]))

  data$metric_key <- names(metric_labels)[match(as.character(data$metric),
                                                metric_labels)]

  # Aggregate over design factors (true_p, candidate_p, prevalence) —
  # group only by (metric, family, computation, epv).
  agg <- data %>%
    group_by(metric, metric_key, family, computation, epv) %>%
    summarise(
      n_scen = sum(!is.na(value)),
      center = compute_center(value, get_summary_spec(first(metric_key), summary_spec)$center),
      lo     = compute_lower(value, get_summary_spec(first(metric_key), summary_spec)$range),
      hi     = compute_upper(value, get_summary_spec(first(metric_key), summary_spec)$range),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(-metric_key)

  ref_df <- data.frame(
    metric_key = names(metric_reference),
    yint       = unlist(metric_reference)
  ) %>%
    mutate(metric = factor(metric_labels[metric_key],
                           levels = metric_labels[metric_order])) %>%
    filter(!is.na(metric)) %>%
    select(metric, yint)

  # ---- Anchor points to force per-row y-limits to match main plots ----
  agg_anchors <- NULL
  if (!is.null(y_limits)) {
    families_present <- levels(droplevels(agg$family))
    epvs_present     <- unique(agg$epv)
    base_grid <- expand.grid(
      metric = unique(agg$metric),
      family = families_present,
      epv    = epvs_present,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    base_grid <- base_grid %>%
      left_join(y_limits, by = "metric") %>%
      filter(!is.na(ymin), !is.na(ymax))
    agg_anchors <- bind_rows(
      base_grid %>% mutate(center = ymin),
      base_grid %>% mutate(center = ymax)
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        lo          = center,
        hi          = center,
        computation = factor(computation_order[1], levels = computation_order),
        family      = factor(family, levels = family_order),
        metric      = factor(metric, levels = metric_labels[metric_order])
      ) %>%
      select(metric, family, computation, epv, center, lo, hi)
  }

  family_labeller <- function(x) family_labels[as.character(x)]
  dodge_width <- 0.6

  p <- ggplot(agg, aes(x = factor(epv), y = center,
                       color = computation, shape = computation,
                       group = computation)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                  width = 0.3,
                  position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
                  linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8,
               position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
    ggh4x::facet_grid2(
      rows = vars(metric),
      cols = vars(family),
      labeller = labeller(family = family_labeller),
      scales = "free_y",
      switch = "x"  # 1. Moves the column (family) labels to the bottom
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = computation_colors,
                       labels = computation_labels[computation_order],
                       breaks = computation_order,
                       drop = FALSE, name = "Computation") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = computation_shapes,
                       labels = computation_labels[computation_order],
                       breaks = computation_order,
                       drop = FALSE, name = "Computation") +
    labs(
      title    = NULL,
      subtitle = NULL,
      x = "Events per variable (EPV)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = NA),
      strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
      strip.text.y       = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
      strip.placement    = "outside", # 2. Places bottom labels cleanly beneath the X-axis numbers
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 9),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1),
           shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

  if (!is.null(agg_anchors)) {
    p <- p + geom_blank(data = agg_anchors, aes(y = center))
  }

  if (nrow(ref_df) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_hline(
      data = ref_df,
      aes(yintercept = yint),
      linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
  }

  p
}

build_computation_plot_rel <- function(data, figure_title = NULL,
                                   metric_order  = default_metric_order,
                                   summary_spec  = metric_summary_spec,
                                   y_limits      = NULL) {

  pm_keys <- unique(as.character(data$method))
  pm_keys <- pm_keys[grepl("^pm_", pm_keys)]
  parsed  <- t(sapply(pm_keys, parse_pm_method))
  valid   <- !is.na(parsed[, "family"]) &
             parsed[, "family"]      %in% family_order &
             parsed[, "computation"] %in% computation_order
  pm_keys <- pm_keys[valid]
  parsed  <- parsed[valid, , drop = FALSE]

  if (length(pm_keys) == 0) {
    warning("No PM methods found for computation-comparison plot")
    return(NULL)
  }

  key_to_family <- setNames(parsed[, "family"], pm_keys)
  key_to_comp   <- setNames(parsed[, "computation"], pm_keys)

  # 1. Initial Prep
  data_prepared <- data %>%
    filter(as.character(method) %in% pm_keys) %>%
    mutate(
      method      = as.character(method),
      family      = factor(unname(key_to_family[method]), levels = family_order),
      computation = factor(unname(key_to_comp[method]),   levels = computation_order),
      metric_key  = names(metric_labels)[match(as.character(metric), metric_labels)]
    ) %>%
    filter(metric_key %in% metric_order) %>%
    mutate(metric = factor(as.character(metric), levels = metric_labels[metric_order]))

  # 2. Extract Exact values per replicate paired by iteration (and scenario factors)
  # In this sim, unique scenarios are defined by epv, true_p, candidate_p, and prevalence
  exact_vals <- data_prepared %>%
    filter(computation == "exact") %>%
    select(metric, family, epv, true_p, candidate_p, prevalence, iteration, exact_value = value)

  # 3. Calculate SD of paired differences and absolute centers
  agg <- data_prepared %>%
    left_join(exact_vals, by = c("metric", "family", "epv", "true_p", "candidate_p", "prevalence", "iteration")) %>%
    mutate(diff = value - exact_value) %>%
    group_by(metric, metric_key, family, computation, epv) %>%
    summarise(
      center  = compute_center(value, get_summary_spec(first(metric_key), summary_spec)$center),
      diff_sd = sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Whiskers show SD of paired difference, centered on the method's own absolute mean
      # We skip whiskers for the 'exact' method itself as it is the reference
      lo = ifelse(computation == "exact", NA, center - diff_sd),
      hi = ifelse(computation == "exact", NA, center + diff_sd)
    )

  # 4. Anchor points to force per-row y-limits to match main plots
  agg_anchors <- NULL
  if (!is.null(y_limits)) {
    families_present <- levels(droplevels(agg$family))
    epvs_present     <- unique(agg$epv)
    base_grid <- expand.grid(
      metric = unique(agg$metric),
      family = families_present,
      epv    = epvs_present,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>%
      left_join(y_limits, by = "metric")
    
    agg_anchors <- bind_rows(
      base_grid %>% mutate(center = ymin),
      base_grid %>% mutate(center = ymax)
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        lo = center, hi = center,
        computation = factor(computation_order[1], levels = computation_order),
        family      = factor(family, levels = family_order),
        metric      = factor(metric, levels = levels(agg$metric))
      )
  }

  # 5. Plotting
  family_labeller <- function(x) family_labels[as.character(x)]
  dodge_width <- 0.6

  p <- ggplot(agg, aes(x = factor(epv), y = center, color = computation, shape = computation, group = computation)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                  width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width), linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8, position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
    ggh4x::facet_grid2(
      rows = vars(metric), cols = vars(family),
      labeller = labeller(family = family_labeller),
      scales = "free_y"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = computation_colors, labels = computation_labels, name = "Computation") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = computation_shapes, labels = computation_labels, name = "Computation") +
    labs(x = "Events per variable (EPV)", y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = NA),
      strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )

  if (!is.null(agg_anchors)) {
    p <- p + geom_blank(data = agg_anchors, aes(y = center))
  }

  # Reference lines for absolute values
  ref_df <- data.frame(metric_key = names(metric_reference), yint = unlist(metric_reference)) %>%
    mutate(metric = factor(metric_labels[metric_key], levels = levels(agg$metric))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(metric))

  if (nrow(ref_df) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_hline(data = ref_df, aes(yintercept = yint), 
                        linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4)
  }

  p
}

# ---- Build the comp plot ----
main_ylims <- get_main_plot_ylims(res_plot)
# Main-plot metric column uses labels (not keys) after res_plot prep, so
# translate keys to labels for matching.
main_ylims <- main_ylims %>%
  mutate(metric = unname(metric_labels[metric]))

# Relative-to-exact (comp_rel_to_exact = TRUE) uses build_computation_plot_rel
# on a free y-scale; absolute mode keeps the shared main_ylims. Same output
# filename either way so downstream references don't change.
comp_metric_order <- c(default_metric_order, "snb0.25", "snb0.5", "snb0.75")
plots$pm_comp <- if (comp_rel_to_exact) {
  build_computation_plot_rel(res_plot, NULL,
                             metric_order = comp_metric_order,
                             y_limits = NULL)
} else {
  build_computation_plot(res_plot, NULL,
                         metric_order = comp_metric_order,
                         y_limits = main_ylims)
}

ggsave(file.path(res_dir, "sim_synth_pm.png"),
       plots$pm_comp, width = 12, height = 14, dpi = 200)



# =========================================================================
# CrI coverage plot — credible-interval coverage stratified by specification
# regime, intended for the appendix.
#
# Posterior calibration is summarised more comprehensively in the main-text
# table (CrI coverage + PIT-based metrics, marginalised over regime). This
# plot retains the regime stratification for readers who want the
# regime-specific story.
#
# Only the four Bayesian PE keys (pe_f / pe_j / pe_lf / pe_br) appear;
# CV-tuned LASSO/ridge are excluded (no Laplace posterior).
# =========================================================================

# Laplace-posterior families plus the two exact-posterior MCMC gold standards.
# All carry cri_cov_* / pit_F_* rows; the MCMC ones use empirical (draw-based)
# intervals rather than the Gaussian Laplace intervals.
coverage_methods <- c("pe_f", "pe_j", "pe_lf", "pe_br",
                      "pm_br_mcmc")
coverage_colors  <- method_colors[coverage_methods]
coverage_shapes  <- method_shapes[coverage_methods]
coverage_labels  <- c(pe_f          = "Flat",
                      pe_j          = "Jeffreys",
                      pe_lf         = "log-F",
                      pe_br         = "Gaussian (Bayes. ridge)",
                      pm_br_mcmc    = "MCMC ridge (exact)")


build_coverage_plot <- function(data,
                                col_factors    = c("true_p", "candidate_p",
                                                   "prevalence", "epv"),
                                col_factor_lbl = c(true_p      = "True predictors",
                                                   candidate_p = "Candidate predictors",
                                                   prevalence  = "Prevalence",
                                                   epv         = "EPV"),
                                figure_title   = NULL) {

  data <- data %>%
    filter(as.character(method) %in% coverage_methods,
           grepl("^cri_cov_", as.character(metric))) %>%
    mutate(method = factor(as.character(method), levels = coverage_methods),
           metric = as.character(metric))

  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    warning("build_coverage_plot: no cri_cov_* rows found; check that ",
            "settings$cri_cov was non-empty when the simulation ran.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  data <- data %>%
    mutate(spec_regime = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        candidate_p <  true_p ~ "Underspecified",
        candidate_p == true_p ~ "Correctly specified",
        candidate_p >  true_p ~ "Overspecified"
      ),
      levels = c("Underspecified", "Correctly specified", "Overspecified")
    ))

  # Coverage level (target value) parsed from the metric name.
  data$cov_level <- as.numeric(sub("^cri_cov_", "", data$metric)) / 100

  # Per-design-factor aggregation. spec_regime kept in the grouping so
  # the three regimes remain separated regardless of which col_factor we
  # collapse over.
  agg_one <- function(col_var) {
    data %>%
      group_by(cov_level, spec_regime, method, !!sym(col_var)) %>%
      summarise(
        n_sim  = sum(!is.na(value)),
        center = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        lo     = quantile(value, q_range[1], na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
        hi     = quantile(value, q_range[2], na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      rename(x_value_raw = !!sym(col_var)) %>%
      mutate(col_factor = col_var,
             x_value    = factor(as.character(x_value_raw),
                                 levels = as.character(sort(unique(x_value_raw))))) %>%
      select(-x_value_raw)
  }
  agg <- bind_rows(lapply(col_factors, agg_one))

  # Numeric x-axis sort across all design factors.
  agg$x_value <- factor(
    as.character(agg$x_value),
    levels = unique(as.character(agg$x_value))[
      order(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unique(as.character(agg$x_value)))))
    ]
  )
  agg$col_factor <- factor(agg$col_factor,
                           levels = col_factors,
                           labels = unname(col_factor_lbl[col_factors]))

  # Reference line at the nominal coverage level (typically 0.95).
  ref_df <- data %>% distinct(cov_level) %>% rename(yint = cov_level)

  dodge_width <- 0.6

  ggplot(agg, aes(x = x_value, y = center,
                  color = method, shape = method, group = method)) +
    geom_hline(data = ref_df, aes(yintercept = yint),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.3,
                  position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width), linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
    ggh4x::facet_grid2(
      rows = vars(spec_regime),
      cols = vars(col_factor),
      scales = "free"
      # `scales = "free"` (no `independent`) gives row-shared y-scale and
      # column-shared x-scale: y-ticks only in leftmost column, x-ticks
      # only in bottom row. Same convention as build_marginal_plot.
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = coverage_colors, labels = coverage_labels,
                       breaks = coverage_methods, drop = FALSE, name = "Prior") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = coverage_shapes, labels = coverage_labels,
                       breaks = coverage_methods, drop = FALSE, name = "Prior") +
    labs(
      title    = NULL,
      subtitle = NULL,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Empirical coverage"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = NA),
      strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      strip.text.y       = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, size = 8),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 9),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
           shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))
}


# ---- Appendix figure: coverage stratified by specification regime ----
plots$coverage_by_regime <- build_coverage_plot(
  res_plot,
  figure_title = "CrI coverage by prior family and specification regime"
)
ggsave(file.path(res_dir, "sim_synth_coverage_by_regime.png"),
       plots$coverage_by_regime, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 200)


# =========================================================================
# Posterior calibration table — main-text summary.
#
# 12 rows (4 priors x 3 EPV levels) x 4 metric columns:
#   - CrI coverage (target = 0.95)
#   - F_emp(0.10)  (target = 0.10)
#   - F_emp(0.50)  (target = 0.50)
#   - F_emp(0.90)  (target = 0.90)
# Saved as RDS in a tidy long format with raw mean and SD across
# replicates per (prior, EPV, metric) cell. The manuscript Rmd can
# pivot/format/style this however it likes (e.g., kable + kableExtra).
# Marginalised over specification regime, prevalence, true_p, and
# candidate_p — the regime story is in the appendix coverage figure.
# =========================================================================

posterior_table <- res_plot %>%
  filter(as.character(method) %in% coverage_methods,
         as.character(metric) %in% c("cri_cov_95", "pit_F_10", "pit_F_50", "pit_F_90")) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(as.character(method),
                         levels = coverage_methods,
                         labels = unname(coverage_labels[coverage_methods])),
         metric = factor(as.character(metric),
                         levels = c("cri_cov_95", "pit_F_10", "pit_F_50", "pit_F_90"),
                         labels = c("Coverage 95%", "PIT F(0.10)",
                                    "PIT F(0.50)", "PIT F(0.90)"))) %>%
  group_by(method, epv, metric) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_val   = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE), #/sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
            n_rep    = sum(!is.na(value)),
            .groups  = "drop") %>%
  arrange(method, epv, metric) %>%
  rename(prior = method, EPV = epv)

saveRDS(posterior_table,
        file = file.path(res_dir, "sim_synth_posterior_table.rds"))

message("Saved coverage figure and posterior-calibration table to ", res_dir, "/")

kable(posterior_table)
```




## Summary sNB table
```{r snb-pm-pe-summary}

res <- readRDS(paste0(res_dir, "sim_synth_results.rds"))

# =========================================================================
# Summary: standardized net-benefit difference between PM and PE, by prior.
#
# Mirrors the GUSTO NB table, adapted to the synthetic design:
#   - metric    : snb<z> (standardized NB at risk-quantile thresholds)
#   - grouping  : by EPV (marginalised over true_p, candidate_p, prevalence,
#                 correlation) -> one row per prior x EPV x z
#
# PM and PE share the same simulated dataset within each replicate ROW, so the
# PM - PE difference is PAIRED. The posterior-mean gain is expressed as an
# equivalent EPV* (computed below), replacing the earlier doubling-EPV ratio.
# =========================================================================
priors_nb   <- c(f = "Flat", j = "Jeffreys", lf = "log-F", br = "Bayesian ridge")
snb_metrics <- grep("^snb", unique(as.character(res$metric)), value = TRUE)

# Per-replicate paired (pm, pe) at each (row, EPV, z, prior).
snb_rep <- res %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% snb_metrics,
         as.character(method) %in% c(paste0("pe_", names(priors_nb)),
                                     paste0("pm_", names(priors_nb)))) %>%
  mutate(method    = as.character(method),
         estimator = ifelse(startsWith(method, "pm_"), "pm", "pe"),
         prior     = sub("^p[me]_", "", method),
         z         = as.numeric(sub("^snb", "", metric))) %>%
  select(row_idx, epv, z, prior, estimator, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = estimator, values_from = value) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pm), !is.na(pe))

snb_pm_pe_diff <- snb_rep %>%
  group_by(prior, epv, z) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rep          = dplyr::n(),
    mean_pe        = mean(pe),
    se_pe          = sd(pe) / sqrt(n_rep),          # MC SE of mean sNB(PE)
    mean_pm        = mean(pm),
    se_pm          = sd(pm) / sqrt(n_rep),          # MC SE of mean sNB(PM)
    mean_diff      = mean(pm - pe),                 # mean paired PM - PE
    se_diff        = sd(pm - pe) / sqrt(n_rep),     # SE of the mean paired diff
    prop_pm_higher = mean((pm - pe) > 0),           # fraction of reps PM > PE
    .groups        = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prior_label = unname(priors_nb[prior]),
         pct_improvement = dplyr::case_when(
           mean_pe <= 0 & mean_pm > 0 ~ Inf,
           mean_pe == 0               ~ NA_real_,
           TRUE                       ~ 100 * (mean_pm - mean_pe) / abs(mean_pe)
         )) %>%
  arrange(match(prior, names(priors_nb)), epv, z) %>%
  select(prior, prior_label, epv, z, n_rep, mean_pe, se_pe, mean_pm, se_pm,
         mean_diff, se_diff, prop_pm_higher, pct_improvement)

# (The PM-vs-doubling-EPV comparison and its stratified bootstrap CI were
# removed; the posterior-mean gain is now expressed via the equivalent EPV*,
# computed below.)

# (snb_pm_pe_diff is saved AFTER EPV* is added below, so the saved object
# carries the epvstar column used by the manuscript prose.)

# --- EPV*: plug-in EPV matching PM's standardized net benefit ---------------
# Ceiling snb_inf = the candidate model at its PSEUDO-TRUE coefficients (the
# EPV -> infinity limit that PE and PM both converge to), evaluated on each
# scenario's population with the SAME sNB definition used in the simulation
# (soft labels, threshold = quantile of true risk, divided by prevalence).
# Computed POST-HOC by regenerating populations (generate_from_design is
# deterministic, so this reproduces the exact populations the sim used; no MCMC
# re-run needed), averaged over a capped number of iterations per scenario (the
# true model is redrawn per iteration) and over scenarios -> one prior- and
# EPV-independent ceiling per threshold z. Cached; delete the rds to recompute.
snb_inf_file <- file.path(res_dir, "synth_snb_inf.rds")
if (file.exists(snb_inf_file)) {
  snb_inf_tbl <- readRDS(snb_inf_file)
} else {
  n_ceiling_iter <- 50L                       # iterations/scenario for the ceiling
  ceiling_idx <- df_design %>%
    dplyr::mutate(.idx = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(scenario) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = n_ceiling_iter) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.idx)
  snb_inf_tbl <- lapply(ceiling_idx, function(ix) {
    sp   <- generate_from_design(df_design, ix, settings)
    pit  <- sp$pi_true_pop
    pseu <- plogis(sp$eta_pseudo_pop)          # pseudo-true candidate predictions
    prev <- sp$design_row$prevalence
    do.call(rbind, lapply(settings$z_quant, function(zm) {
      z  <- quantile(pit, zm)
      st <- pit - (1 - pit) * z / (1 - z)
      s0 <- max(0, mean(st))
      data.frame(z = zm, snb_inf = (mean((pseu >= z) * st) - s0) / prev)
    }))
  }) %>% dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(z) %>% dplyr::summarise(snb_inf = mean(snb_inf), .groups = "drop")
  saveRDS(snb_inf_tbl, snb_inf_file)
}

snb_pm_pe_diff <- snb_pm_pe_diff %>% left_join(snb_inf_tbl, by = "z")

# Inverse-power learning curve (Figueroa): sNB(EPV) = snb_inf - b * EPV^c, with
# snb_inf fixed (pseudo-true ceiling). Decay exponent c per (prior, z) = log-log
# slope of the gap to the ceiling over the three EPVs; guard c >= 0 -> -1.
c_fit <- snb_pm_pe_diff %>%
  group_by(prior, z) %>%
  summarise(c_exp = {
      g <- snb_inf - mean_pe; ok <- is.finite(g) & g > 0
      if (sum(ok) >= 2) unname(coef(lm(log(g[ok]) ~ log(epv[ok])))[2]) else NA_real_
    }, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(c_exp = ifelse(is.finite(c_exp) & c_exp < 0, c_exp, -1))

# EPV* = anchored power-law regret ratio: PE's curve forced through its observed
# EPV0 point with exponent c, so
#   EPV* = EPV0 * [ (snb_inf - sNB_PM(EPV0)) / (snb_inf - sNB_PE(EPV0)) ]^(1/c).
# Reduces to the 1/EPV form at c = -1; sign-consistent with ΔsNB for any c < 0.
snb_pm_pe_diff <- snb_pm_pe_diff %>%
  left_join(c_fit, by = c("prior", "z")) %>%
  mutate(epvstar = dplyr::case_when(
                     (snb_inf - mean_pm) <= 0 ~ Inf,       # PM at/above ceiling
                     (snb_inf - mean_pe) <= 0 ~ NA_real_,  # PE at/above ceiling at EPV0
                     TRUE ~ epv * ((snb_inf - mean_pm) / (snb_inf - mean_pe))^(1 / c_exp)))

# Saved with the epvstar column for the manuscript prose / table chunks.
saveRDS(snb_pm_pe_diff, file = file.path(res_dir, "synth_snb_pm_pe_diff.rds"))

# --- Clean manuscript table (mirrors GUSTO) -------------------------------
# Thresholds become columns (wide format); SEs dropped for readability.
# Rows: EPV x prior, sorted EPV first then prior. The four priors carry PE /
# PM / ΔsNB / EPV*. Frequentist ridge (plug-in only) and MCMC ridge (posterior
# mean only) are single-prediction comparators: one sNB column filled, the rest
# NA (blank). They appear at the bottom of each EPV block.

snb_zvals   <- sort(unique(snb_pm_pe_diff$z))
snb_zlabels <- sprintf("z=%.2f", snb_zvals)

# Single-prediction comparators
snb_comparator_methods <- c(pe_ridge_min = "Ridge (CV-min)",
                            pm_br_mcmc   = "Bayesian ridge (MCMC)")
snb_comp_long <- res %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% paste0("snb", snb_zvals),
         as.character(method)  %in% names(snb_comparator_methods),
         !is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(method = as.character(method),
         z      = as.numeric(sub("^snb", "", metric))) %>%
  group_by(method, epv, z) %>%
  summarise(mean_snb = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prior_label = unname(snb_comparator_methods[method]),
         mean_pe   = ifelse(startsWith(method, "pe_"), mean_snb, NA_real_),
         mean_pm   = ifelse(startsWith(method, "pm_"), mean_snb, NA_real_),
         mean_diff = NA_real_,
         epvstar   = NA_real_) %>%
  select(prior_label, epv, z, mean_pe, mean_pm, mean_diff, epvstar)

# Prior ordering: four priors first, comparators last within each EPV block
snb_prior_levels <- c(unname(priors_nb), unname(snb_comparator_methods))

snb_long <- bind_rows(
  snb_pm_pe_diff %>% select(prior_label, epv, z, mean_pe, mean_pm, mean_diff, epvstar),
  snb_comp_long
) %>%
  mutate(prior_label = factor(prior_label, levels = snb_prior_levels)) %>%
  arrange(epv, prior_label, z)

snb_table <- snb_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(epv, prior_label),
    names_from  = z,
    values_from = c(mean_pe, mean_pm, mean_diff, epvstar),
    names_glue  = "{.value}__{z}"
  ) %>%
  arrange(epv, prior_label)

# Re-order columns: EPV, Prior, then per threshold PE / PM / ΔsNB / EPV*
ordered_cols <- c("epv", "prior_label")
for (zv in snb_zvals) {
  ordered_cols <- c(ordered_cols,
    paste0("mean_pe__",   zv),
    paste0("mean_pm__",   zv),
    paste0("mean_diff__", zv),
    paste0("epvstar__",   zv))
}
snb_table <- snb_table[, ordered_cols]

# Round sNB-scale columns to 4 dp; EPV* to 1 dp; NA stays NA -> blank
num_cols     <- setdiff(colnames(snb_table), c("epv", "prior_label"))
epvstar_cols <- grep("^epvstar__", num_cols, value = TRUE)
other_cols   <- setdiff(num_cols, epvstar_cols)
snb_table[, other_cols]   <- lapply(snb_table[, other_cols],   function(x) round(x, 4))
snb_table[, epvstar_cols] <- lapply(snb_table[, epvstar_cols], function(x) round(x, 1))

kable(snb_table,
      col.names = c("EPV", "Prior",
                    rep(c("PE", "PM", "ΔsNB", "EPV*"), length(snb_zvals))),
      caption   = "Synthetic simulations: standardized net benefit by prior and EPV, with PE-equivalent EPV* (frequentist and MCMC ridge are single-prediction comparators)")

saveRDS(list(snb_table = snb_table, zvals = snb_zvals, zlabels = snb_zlabels),
        file = file.path(res_dir, "synth_snb_table.rds"))
```

```{r synth-se-tables, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =========================================================================
# Monte Carlo SE tables — synthetic simulations.
# Mirrors gusto-se-tables; key differences:
#   - groups by epv (not n)
#   - adds dkl and cal_int to stat metrics
#   - sNB keys are snb0.25 / snb0.5 / snb0.75
#   - ΔsNB pairing uses row_idx (shared design row within each replicate)
# =========================================================================
res_se <- readRDS(file.path(res_dir, "sim_synth_results.rds"))

se_methods_s  <- c("pe_f","pm_f","pe_j","pm_j","pe_lf","pm_lf","pe_br","pm_br",
                   "pe_ridge_min","pm_br_mcmc")
prior_of_s    <- c(pe_f="Flat", pm_f="Flat", pe_j="Jeffreys", pm_j="Jeffreys",
                   pe_lf="log-F", pm_lf="log-F", pe_br="Bayesian ridge", pm_br="Bayesian ridge",
                   pe_ridge_min="Ridge (CV-min)", pm_br_mcmc="Bayesian ridge (MCMC)")
prior_lv_s    <- c("Flat","Jeffreys","log-F","Bayesian ridge",
                   "Ridge (CV-min)","Bayesian ridge (MCMC)")
priors_nb_s   <- c(f="Flat", j="Jeffreys", lf="log-F", br="Bayesian ridge")
center_map_s  <- c(dkl="median", mse="mean", cstat="mean",
                   oe_ratio="median", cal_int="median", cal_slp="median")
metric_lab_s  <- c(dkl="$D_{KL}$", mse="MSE", cstat="C-statistic",
                   oe_ratio="O/E ratio", cal_int="Cal. intercept",
                   cal_slp="Calibration slope")

B_se_s <- 1000
se_of_s <- function(v, ctr) {
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  if (length(v) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  if (ctr == "mean") return(sd(v) / sqrt(length(v)))
  sd(vapply(seq_len(B_se_s), function(b)
      median(sample(v, length(v), replace = TRUE)), numeric(1)))
}
ctr_of_s <- function(v, ctr) {
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]; if (!length(v)) return(NA_real_)
  if (ctr == "mean") mean(v) else median(v)
}

# --- Statistical metrics ---
set.seed(settings$seed)
synth_se_stat <- res_se %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% names(center_map_s),
         as.character(method) %in% se_methods_s) %>%
  mutate(metric = as.character(metric), method = as.character(method)) %>%
  group_by(metric, method, epv) %>%
  summarise(n_rep = sum(is.finite(value)),
            est   = ctr_of_s(value, center_map_s[[dplyr::first(metric)]]),
            se    = se_of_s (value, center_map_s[[dplyr::first(metric)]]),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prior  = factor(prior_of_s[method], levels = prior_lv_s),
         type   = ifelse(startsWith(method, "pm_"), "PM", "PE"),
         metric = factor(metric_lab_s[metric], levels = unname(metric_lab_s))) %>%
  arrange(metric, prior, type, epv)
saveRDS(synth_se_stat, file.path(res_dir, "synth_se_stat.rds"))

# --- sNB per-method SE (mean SE of sNB) ---
snb_keys_s <- grep("^snb", unique(as.character(res_se$metric)), value = TRUE)
synth_se_snb <- res_se %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% snb_keys_s,
         as.character(method) %in% se_methods_s) %>%
  mutate(method = as.character(method),
         z      = as.numeric(sub("^snb", "", metric))) %>%
  group_by(method, epv, z) %>%
  summarise(n_rep = sum(is.finite(value)),
            est   = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            se    = sd(value,  na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(is.finite(value))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prior = factor(prior_of_s[method], levels = prior_lv_s),
         type  = ifelse(startsWith(method, "pm_"), "PM", "PE")) %>%
  arrange(z, prior, type, epv)
saveRDS(synth_se_snb, file.path(res_dir, "synth_se_snb.rds"))

# --- ΔsNB = PM - PE (paired via row_idx) ---
synth_se_dnb <- res_se %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% snb_keys_s,
         as.character(method) %in% c(paste0("pe_", names(priors_nb_s)),
                                     paste0("pm_", names(priors_nb_s)))) %>%
  mutate(method    = as.character(method),
         estimator = ifelse(startsWith(method, "pm_"), "pm", "pe"),
         prior     = sub("^p[me]_", "", method),
         z         = as.numeric(sub("^snb", "", metric))) %>%
  select(row_idx, epv, z, prior, estimator, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = estimator, values_from = value) %>%
  filter(is.finite(pe), is.finite(pm)) %>%
  group_by(prior, epv, z) %>%
  summarise(n_rep   = dplyr::n(),
            est     = mean(pm - pe),
            se_diff = sd(pm - pe) / sqrt(n_rep), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prior_label = factor(unname(priors_nb_s[prior]), levels = prior_lv_s)) %>%
  arrange(z, prior_label, epv) %>%
  select(prior_label, epv, z, n_rep, est, se_diff)
saveRDS(synth_se_dnb, file.path(res_dir, "synth_se_dnb.rds"))

cat("Synth SE: stat =", nrow(synth_se_stat),
    "| snb =", nrow(synth_se_snb),
    "| dnb =", nrow(synth_se_dnb), "rows\n")
knitr::kable(head(synth_se_stat, 8), digits = 5,
             caption = "Preview: synthetic MC SE (stat metrics)")
```

```{r synth-se-comp, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# SE for three PM computation methods — synthetic simulations.
# Mirrors gusto-se-comp; groups by epv.
comp_m_all_s <- c("pm_f","pm_f_mk","pm_f_pp",
                  "pm_j","pm_j_mk","pm_j_pp",
                  "pm_lf","pm_lf_mk","pm_lf_pp",
                  "pm_br","pm_br_mk","pm_br_pp")
comp_m_s <- intersect(comp_m_all_s, unique(as.character(res_se$method)))

prior_of_comp_s <- setNames(
  rep(c("Flat","Jeffreys","log-F","Bayesian ridge"), each = 3),
  c("pm_f","pm_f_mk","pm_f_pp",
    "pm_j","pm_j_mk","pm_j_pp",
    "pm_lf","pm_lf_mk","pm_lf_pp",
    "pm_br","pm_br_mk","pm_br_pp"))
comp_of_m_s <- function(m) {
  parts <- strsplit(m, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) <= 2) "exact" else parts[3]
}

set.seed(settings$seed)
synth_se_comp_stat <- res_se %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% names(center_map_s),
         as.character(method) %in% comp_m_s) %>%
  mutate(metric = as.character(metric), method = as.character(method)) %>%
  group_by(metric, method, epv) %>%
  summarise(est = ctr_of_s(value, center_map_s[[dplyr::first(metric)]]),
            se  = se_of_s (value, center_map_s[[dplyr::first(metric)]]),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prior        = factor(prior_of_comp_s[method], levels = prior_lv_s),
         comp         = vapply(method, comp_of_m_s, character(1)),
         metric_label = factor(metric_lab_s[metric], levels = unname(metric_lab_s))) %>%
  select(metric_label, prior, epv, comp, est, se) %>%
  arrange(metric_label, prior, epv, comp)

synth_se_comp_snb <- res_se %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% snb_keys_s,
         as.character(method) %in% comp_m_s) %>%
  mutate(method = as.character(method),
         z      = as.numeric(sub("^snb", "", metric))) %>%
  group_by(method, epv, z) %>%
  summarise(n_rep = sum(is.finite(value)),
            est   = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            se    = sd(value,  na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(is.finite(value))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prior = factor(prior_of_comp_s[method], levels = prior_lv_s),
         comp  = vapply(method, comp_of_m_s, character(1))) %>%
  select(z, prior, epv, comp, est, se) %>%
  arrange(z, prior, epv, comp)

# --- sNB paired deltas: MacKay - exact and self-proj - exact ---
synth_se_comp_snb_delta <- res_se %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% snb_keys_s,
         as.character(method) %in% comp_m_s) %>%
  mutate(method = as.character(method),
         z      = as.numeric(sub("^snb", "", metric)),
         prior  = prior_of_comp_s[method],
         comp   = vapply(method, comp_of_m_s, character(1))) %>%
  select(prior, epv, z, row_idx, comp, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = comp, values_from = value) %>%
  filter(is.finite(exact)) %>%
  group_by(prior, epv, z) %>%
  summarise(
    est_mk = mean(mk   - exact, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_mk  = sd(mk     - exact, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(is.finite(mk   - exact))),
    est_pp = mean(pp   - exact, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_pp  = sd(pp     - exact, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(is.finite(pp   - exact))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prior = factor(prior, levels = prior_lv_s)) %>%
  arrange(z, prior, epv)

saveRDS(list(stat = synth_se_comp_stat, snb = synth_se_comp_snb,
             snb_delta = synth_se_comp_snb_delta),
        file.path(res_dir, "synth_se_comp.rds"))
cat("Synth comp SE: stat =", nrow(synth_se_comp_stat),
    "| snb =", nrow(synth_se_comp_snb),
```
